## Summary
ESSYS (Essys Co., Ltd., Korean (주)이씨스) is a South Korean IEEE registrant with six MA-L blocks under two spellings: 68:84:70 (registered 7 May 2011) as "eSSys Co.,Ltd" at Daerung Post Tower 5, 15F, Geumcheon-gu, Seoul [1][6][8], and A8:B9:B3 (2013), 28:CF:08 (2017), 48:7A:FF (2020), EC:AB:3E (2023) and C0:CA:A2 (May 2026) as "ESSYS", the later ones at Gaetbeol-ro, Incheon [1][7]. The registry gives the company website as www.essys.co.kr [7], but both the Korean and English company sites are membership portals that present only a login gate with no product, history or business pages [2][4]; the English site's footer gives CEO Hyung jun Ahn, corporate registration 106-86-38429 and "55 Gaetbeol-ro, Yeonsu-gu, Incheon (Essys Research Lab)" as its address [2], and Korean Wikipedia's street article places the "Essys연구소" at Gaetbeol-ro 55 / Songdo-dong 7-41 in Incheon's Songdo district [3]. No public documentation of its products was found in the sources reachable this session: Wikidata has no entry for the company [5], no DeviWiki or OpenWrt page was located, the FCC ID mirrors refused the fetch, and web search was unavailable, so product class, radios, chipsets, FCC grantee code, founding year and parent are left unknown rather than guessed. Six 24-bit blocks, the newest from 2026, is a substantial allocation for a company with no consumer presence [7], so treat a device in these blocks as an unidentified Korean-made embedded product and identify it from its traffic rather than its OUI.
